vulnerability_mechanism.evidence: At v3.1.6, MessagePackSerializer.TryDecompress accepts Lz4Block type 99 and Lz4BlockArray data, sends attacker-controlled compressed bytes through LZ4Codec.Decode, and LZ4_uncompress_32/64 advances src_p through token, literal-length, offset, and match-length reads without any src_end bound; the consumed-length comparison occurs only after the native reads.

atomic_bic.evidence: bf5f2dd91bad2948063668de3703259f7562cf73 first adds the decoder source files to this repository, but it is a vendoring/copy commit. Its immediate parent already references lz4net 1.0.11.93 and calls global::LZ4.LZ4Codec.Decode. Under the protocol, a copy is not the BIC.

immediate_parent_absence.evidence: Parent 23674873e020d8ce96e4bd2b87b3ed2856ce06fa is not non-vulnerable: it creates MessagePack.LZ4, adds PackageReference lz4net 1.0.11.93, and deserializes extension type 99 by calling LZ4Codec.Decode with attacker-controlled bytes. Its parent 03f9c3652adc018c171ec3180909bd9b971ca4a9 lacks MessagePack.LZ4, showing project exposure began before the claimed BIC.

squash_member_decomposition.evidence: Both 23674873e020d8ce96e4bd2b87b3ed2856ce06fa and bf5f2dd91bad2948063668de3703259f7562cf73 are single-parent commits with no merge or squash member recorded locally; the disqualifying topology is dependency adoption followed by vendoring, not a squash.

affected_and_fixed_release_membership.evidence: The claimed BIC is an ancestor of affected v2.5.205, v3.0.214-rc.1, and v3.1.6. Backport 3538bc1110ed8507b394348188c8075d3d8a3dbf is in v2.5.301 and not v2.5.205; v3 fix 719e690abae8d4dba6b0c43088c8ded29cdc1ba2 is in v3.1.7 and not v3.1.6. CVE-2026-48109 is currently PUBLISHED; its CNA v3 range is internally malformed, while the bundled GHSA and Git ancestry support the v3.1.7 boundary.

direct_fix_or_verified_unpatched_state.evidence: 719e690abae8d4dba6b0c43088c8ded29cdc1ba2 is a direct v3 fix: it passes input.Length into both decoders, adds src_end checks before token, literal, offset, and match-length reads, and adds Lz4BlockRejectsTruncatedLiteralRun. 3538bc1110ed8507b394348188c8075d3d8a3dbf is the corresponding v2 backport.

bic_only_ai_attribution.evidence: The no-AI-marker check was performed on bf5f2dd91bad2948063668de3703259f7562cf73, but that commit is a copy rather than the atomic origin. Its human 2017 metadata cannot establish NOT_AI for the unresolved lz4net/LZ4 decoder writer.

findings: Primary incorrectly treats vendoring commit bf5f2dd91bad2948063668de3703259f7562cf73 as the BIC even though its parent already exposes the same vulnerable lz4net decoder to untrusted MessagePack extension data.
Primary's statement that the immediate parent lacks decoder source proves only that code was dependency-provided; it does not prove absence of the vulnerability.
The direct fixes and affected/fixed tag ancestry are independently reproducible, but they do not repair the missing atomic-origin and BIC-only AI-attribution gates.

corrected_fields.flaw_origin: Project exposure is present by 23674873e020d8ce96e4bd2b87b3ed2856ce06fa through lz4net 1.0.11.93; bf5f2dd91bad2948063668de3703259f7562cf73 later copies that decoder into the repository and is not an atomic BIC.

remaining_gap: Resolve the exact lz4net 1.0.11.93 / LZ4 r93 source history and identify the smallest original commit that first wrote the unbounded fast-decoder lines; then verify its immediate parent, any copy/squash members, and AI markers on that exact writer.
